title: SB49 (2024 Regular): RELATING TO FIREARMS.

operative_text: SECTION 1 (new): It shall be unlawful for a person to possess a loaded firearm while the person is intoxicated. (b) Any person violating this section shall be guilty of a petty misdemeanor.
